final: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, st.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scans AS matched JOIN sites AS site ON site.zoneregistry = matched.zoneref) AS share_of_matched_scans FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.riskeval ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC LIMIT 10
